facts.fact: In the foreword to the Ministry of Health's 2024-25 sector performance report the Minister of Health calls DHIS2 the ministry's official national health information platform, says the report is based on data captured in it, and urges stakeholders to rely on it and avoid parallel data platforms; the foreword is undated, so the published date is used.
